title: FOSSEE Winter Internship 2026
description: Remote winter internship where students contribute to open-source scientific software projects such as eSim, Osdag and DWSIM after clearing a short screening task.

eligibility.notes: Open to students at Indian institutions; selection is based on a screening task; internship runs from 7 December 2026.

title: India Space Lab Winter Internship 2026 (Batch II)
description: Research internship in space science and engineering with mentoring from ISRO-linked scientists, run in two batches for Indian and international students.

eligibility.notes: Batch II registration closes 18 December 2026; open to undergraduate, postgraduate and research scholars in India or abroad.

title: Science Academies' Summer Research Fellowship Programme 2027
organization: Indian Academy of Sciences, INSA and NASI
description: Two-month summer research fellowship that places selected students with a scientist at an Indian research institution, with a monthly stipend and train fare.

eligibility.notes: Open to undergraduate, postgraduate and integrated-degree students at UGC/AICTE-recognised institutions; only one application per candidate; fellowship runs in summer 2027.

title: Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2026-27
description: Scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh per year for girl students from low-income families pursuing a professional undergraduate degree, paid for the full course duration.

eligibility.notes: Girl students with at least 75% in Class 12, annual family income up to INR 6 lakh, admitted to first year of an eligible professional course in 2026-27.

title: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students (Technical Degree)
description: Scholarship of INR 50,000 per year for girl students in AICTE-approved technical degree programmes, covering tuition fees and incidentals.

eligibility.notes: Girl students only; annual family income up to INR 8 lakh; a maximum of two girls per family may apply; applications through the National Scholarship Portal.

title: AICTE Swanath Scholarship (Technical Degree)
description: Scholarship of INR 50,000 per year for orphans, wards of armed forces or police martyrs, and students who lost parents to COVID-19, studying an AICTE-approved technical degree.

eligibility.notes: Requires an orphan, martyr or COVID-19 supporting certificate; annual family income up to INR 8 lakh; applications through the National Scholarship Portal.

title: PM YASASVI Top Class Education Scheme (College)
organization: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Tuition support and living allowance for OBC, EBC and DNT students admitted to colleges listed under the scheme's top-class education programme.

eligibility.notes: For OBC, EBC and DNT students; family income limit applies; the institution must be on the scheme's approved list; applications through the National Scholarship Portal.

title: Federal Bank Hormis Memorial Foundation Scholarship 2026-27
description: Reimbursement of tuition and educational expenses up to INR 1 lakh per year, plus laptop or tablet support, for first-year students in selected professional courses.

eligibility.notes: Applicants must be natives of Andhra Pradesh, Gujarat, Karnataka, Kerala, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu or Telangana; annual family income up to INR 3 lakh; first-year admission in 2026-27.

title: HackWithAditya 2026
description: Two-level student hackathon: submit a working prototype online for free, then shortlisted teams build on-site for 48 hours against enhancement briefs.

eligibility.notes: Teams of 4-6 currently enrolled students in India; Level 1 submission is free; shortlisted teams pay INR 800 per member; event runs 18-20 December 2026.

title: Cosmo Hacks 2026
description: Month-long online hackathon for students with space-themed tracks and beginner-friendly resources, free to enter.

eligibility.notes: Open to students worldwide; submissions run from 19 December 2026 to 18 January 2027; no entry fee.

title: GenHacks
description: Virtual hackathon open to students aged 13 and above worldwide, where participants work solo or in teams and submit a project built during the event.

eligibility.notes: Students only, from any country; submissions open 1 November 2026 and close 26 December 2026; free to enter.

title: IMechE Railway Challenge 2027
description: Engineering competition in which university teams design and build a miniature locomotive, then compete in dynamic and static challenges.

eligibility.notes: Teams may include university students, apprentices and early-career engineers; team registration closes 27 November 2026.

title: Sony World Photography Awards: Student Competition
description: Global photography competition for students, with cash prizes, Sony equipment and exhibition exposure for winning series.

eligibility.notes: Open to students aged 18-30 enrolled in a photography-focused course; free to enter.

title: Farm Robotics Challenge 2027
organization: University of California Agriculture and Natural Resources
description: Competition challenging college teams to build autonomous solutions for real farm tasks using the Amiga robot, with cash prizes for the strongest teams.

eligibility.notes: Open to college students globally; team proposal due 13 December 2026; USD 100 entry fee per team.

title: Rewild the Future Challenge
description: Student challenge to design biodiversity-restoration plans for rural landscapes, with workshops, expert feedback and a final pitch event.

eligibility.notes: Open to Bachelor, Master and PhD students worldwide; registration closes 16 November 2026.
